summary: Work in compositing and layers improves how scrolling and painting updates are organized and synchronized across processes. Key changes include batching compositor scroll updates across IPC, better GPU fence support for Metal ANGLE (so the GPU and compositor coordinate more reliably), and re-recording mask blobs when sub-pixel offsets change. These fixes help deliver smoother, more consistent scrolling and fewer tearing or repaint glitches, especially in multi-process and Metal/ANGLE setups. _Some test adjustments for the newer Nova UI are included._
